answer: Each identity claims one garden bed, tags it with a velvet tag bound to its key, and plants a mirror twin bed with the same seed the same day, locking a 70-credit bond. At harvest a garden auditor weighs both beds on site; the mirror pair must agree within 3%, or the bond burns. Bed slots are scarce: first pair 36 credits, k-th 36+6(k-1), 1000th 6030, 1000 fakes 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-mirror ring fails: one bed carries one serial tag, so a rented bed cannot serve two identities. An honest grower pays 36 once and reclaims the bond after a clean epoch.
